rule.curve: capability D50 and reliability D99 are the crossings of the average-rate curve (the share of attempts expected to fail at a difficulty) at one half and one in a hundred; the median-task D99 beside
rule.number: the median over every exported draw of the crossing, a draw below the easiest task counted beyond the easy end and one beyond the hardest task beyond the hard end; the interval the 10th and 90th percentiles taken the same way
rule.status: point, or bound below / bound above when more than half of the draws lie beyond that end (the value then the easiest or the hardest task used); every arm has a number at every level
rule.levels: D97, D95 and D90 are the same curve's crossings at 3%, 5% and 10% failure; D1 (99% failure) is read from the level table between the bracketing levels, linear in the logit of the level
